purpose: Narrow provider-configuration observations for the external operator exclusion. No provider generation or user configuration mutation.

claude.source: Installed CLI, disposable CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and cwd, dummy loopback HTTP MCP entry
claude.baseline: mcp get recognized the configured entry and dummy URL
claude.observed: mcp list exited 0 and reported no configured servers

codex.source: Installed CLI, disposable provider configuration home and cwd; mcp list --json only
codex.observed: Both returned exactly one reserved entry with enabled=false
codex.limitation: The published control connection is HTTP. A conflicting stdio entry under the reserved name fails provider configuration validation rather than receiving control access.

opencode.source: Official MCP/config precedence documentation and the existing structured/native launch seams
opencode.observed: Local configuration-merge probe preserves other servers and overrides the reserved entry with enabled=false
opencode.limitation: No native OpenCode CLI connection trial was performed here.

continuity: Overrides are placed in provider start paths shared by fresh/resume/recovery. Workflow Codex receives the same disabled entry through its existing SDK config port.
